sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): a steady armoured run, the round shield held before her, the sword low in her far hand, the LEGS STEPPING IN TURN, the hair and the skirt swaying
sheets.weapons: THE SHIELD AND THE SWORD go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the ROUND GOLD SUN SHIELD on her NEAR arm (image left), before her unless she bashes it out ahead; the SWORD in her FAR hand (image right), its silver blade pointing where the pale figure's does. Only ONE shield and ONE sword, the design's.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: the legs exactly as the pale figure: one foot planted, the other lifted or swinging. Frame 2: the legs exactly as the pale figure: one foot planted, the other lifted or swinging. The two legs TAKE TURNS frame by frame as the pale figures show - never the same leg pose in every frame, never both legs stretched apart in every frame; the body bobs with the steps.
